desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on Ukraine’s major strike on the Kerch Strait Bridge and supporting Russian logistics targets, alongside a confirmed Russian An-12 crash and US retaliatory strikes on Iran. The single most important development is the apparent collapse of the Kerch Bridge roadway and arch, severely disrupting Russian supply lines.

## MAIN THREADS
### Kerch Strait Bridge strike
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2122792420785930454) and [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122785925084148158) both posted video from Crimea showing multiple missile/drone impacts causing the road arch and roadway to collapse into the water.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122791355533455654) added close-up footage confirming the scale of the combined strike (jet drones, cruise missiles, regular drones).

### Russian An-12 crash
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2122787729335316944) reported Russia’s Defense Ministry confirmation that all 19 aboard died in the Kemerovo region crash; preliminary cause is technical malfunction.

### US strikes on Iran
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2122784273870762036) cited US officials confirming fighter-jet precision strikes on an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island in self-defense.

### PLA counter-drone training
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2122774022219813096) assessed recent PLA exercises as efforts to build a counter-drone network, drawing lessons from Ukraine.

### Mius River bridge
- [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2122794468856201538) highlighted the strike severing the Taganrog–Mariupol coastal route, forcing a longer northern detour exposed to Ukrainian drones.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2122792528629912056) posted only “Cope” in reply to an unspecified claim (unconfirmed).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2122782814873817240) reported a US federal indictment of Andrew Kozak over an Illinois ethanol-plant bomb threat (unconfirmed by other listed accounts).  
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2122774044567109667) linked to its full China-Taiwan update (unconfirmed by others).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for Russian attempts to restore Kerch Bridge transit and any follow-on Ukrainian strikes on the new northern detour. US–Iran escalation and further PLA counter-drone adaptations are also on the radar.
